text:
samir: Kicking off a quarterly admin-entitlement sweep for the billing/payment services tomorrow. Scope: KMS key ACLs, service-account grants, and any broad "roles/editor"/"roles/owner" bindings on infra projects. Target: identify stale grants and produce an exceptions list with owner and expiry. ETA: 48h.

tara: I'll own the service-account last-used checks. Plan: query Stackdriver logs + IAM token audit. Will post a short script.

leo: I'll do the KMS mapping. Heads-up: some keys are shared across pipelines, so we need owner-confirmation before removal.

maya: Can we avoid pruning during the end-of-month billing cutoff? Suggest maintenance window Thu 03:00-05:00 UTC.

samir: Thu 03:00-05:00 UTC works. Add a canary plan: unbind, wait 30m, monitor errors. If errors spike, revert.

audit-bot: least-priv-scan scheduled: /scans/least_priv/1729998765. Expected runtime: 2024-06-07T03:05:00Z.

tara: Script (will run with read-only creds first):```bash
# svcacct last used (example)
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"svcacct-billing@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"" --limit 1 --format="value(timestamp)"
```
Posting results to: https://files.redwood/internal/least-priv/1729998765/tara-lastused.csv

leo: KMS IAM commands I'll use:```bash
# list keyring members
gcloud kms keyrings get-iam-policy payments-keyring --location=global --format=json
# per-key policy
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy payments-key --location=global --keyring=payments-keyring --format=json
```
I'll include labels and creation time in the CSV.

maya: For exceptions, please include: owner, justification, expiry (max 14 days unless security approves), rollback steps, and a link to the owner confirmation. I'll triage.

audit-bot: scan complete. Summary: 58 IAM bindings scanned; 12 elevated bindings identified; 4 keys with cross-project grants; 7 service accounts listed as "last seen > 90d". Full JSON: /shared/audit/least-priv/1729998765/report.json

samir: Good. Next steps: 1) leo/tara: annotate each candidate with evidence + suggested action 2) maya: review exceptions 3) infra: prepare canary revert playbook. Post updates in this thread.

tara: Uploaded last-used CSV and evidence links. Marked two svcaccts as active despite >90d due to intermittent batch jobs.

leo: Uploaded KMS mapping CSV. Flagged 4 cross-project keys: DO NOT PRUNE without owner sign-off.

audit-bot: owners-reminder sent to flagged owners for confirmation (48h TTL).

samir: Once owners confirm (or TTL expires), we'll do a staged prune: canary on staging -> canary on low-traffic prod -> full prune. We'll keep change window and rollback steps documented. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
